name: How long does a typical garage renovation project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical garage renovation project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a garage renovation project depends on its complexity. A simple cosmetic upgrade might take 3-6 weeks, while a more extensive conversion, such as an ADU that requires new utility hookups and significant structural changes, could take 3-6 months from start to finish, including permit acquisition time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies, from 3-6 weeks for simple upgrades to 3-6 months for extensive conversions like ADUs.
